command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected expression and metadata paths")
expr <- read.csv(args[[1]], header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE,
                 na.strings=c("", "NA"))
meta <- read.csv(args[[2]], header=TRUE, check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE,
                 na.strings=c("", "NA"))
if (ncol(expr) < 2L) stop("Expression matrix must have gene IDs plus sample columns")
if (!("projid" %in% names(meta))) stop("Metadata must contain projid")

gene_ids <- as.character(expr[[1L]])
sample_ids <- as.character(names(expr)[-1L])
meta_ids <- as.character(meta$projid)
if (any(is.na(gene_ids)) || any(gene_ids=="")) stop("Blank gene ID")
if (anyDuplicated(gene_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers are not resolved")
if (any(is.na(sample_ids)) || any(sample_ids=="")) stop("Blank expression sample ID")
if (any(is.na(meta_ids)) || any(meta_ids=="")) stop("Blank metadata projid")
if (!setequal(unique(sample_ids), unique(meta_ids))) stop("Expression and metadata ID sets do not match")
if (!setequal(sample_ids, meta_ids)) stop("Expression and metadata ID multiplicities do not match")

expr_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(sample_ids) > 1L)))
meta_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(meta_ids) > 1L)))
if (!setequal(expr_dup_ids, meta_dup_ids)) stop("Repeated-ID groups do not match")

stable_fields <- setdiff(names(meta), "projid")
metadata_conflict <- setNames(logical(length(meta_dup_ids)), meta_dup_ids)
if (length(meta_dup_ids)>0L && length(stable_fields)>0L) {
  for (id in meta_dup_ids) {
    block <- meta[meta$projid==id, stable_fields, drop=FALSE]
    metadata_conflict[[id]] <- any(vapply(block, function(v) {
      length(unique(v[!is.na(v)])) > 1L
    }, logical(1)))
  }
}
keep_sample <- !(sample_ids %in% expr_dup_ids)
if (sum(keep_sample) < 2L) stop("No resolved samples remain")

raw <- as.matrix(expr[, -1L, drop=FALSE])
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(raw) <- "numeric")
if (any(!is.finite(raw)) || any(raw < 0)) stop("Raw expression has invalid values")
X <- t(raw[, keep_sample, drop=FALSE])
rownames(X) <- sample_ids[keep_sample]
colnames(X) <- gene_ids

pseudocount <- 1
X <- log10(X + pseudocount)
if (any(!is.finite(X))) stop("log10-transformed matrix has non-finite values")
feature_variance <- apply(X, 2L, var)
keep_feature <- is.finite(feature_variance) & feature_variance > 0
if (!any(keep_feature)) stop("No positive-variance genes remain")
X <- X[, keep_feature, drop=FALSE]

requested_components <- 100L
if (nrow(X) <= requested_components) stop("Fewer than 101 resolved samples")
fit <- prcomp(X, center=TRUE, scale.=FALSE, rank.=requested_components)
if (length(fit$sdev) < requested_components) stop("PCA returned fewer than 100 singular values")
eigenvalues <- fit$sdev[seq_len(requested_components)]^2
centered <- sweep(X, 2L, fit$center, "-")
total_variance <- sum(centered^2)/(nrow(X)-1L)
explained_ratio <- eigenvalues/total_variance
explained_percent <- 100*explained_ratio

variance_out <- data.frame(
  component=seq_len(requested_components),
  eigenvalue=eigenvalues,
  explained_variance_ratio=explained_ratio,
  explained_variance_percent=explained_percent,
  cumulative_explained_variance_percent=100*cumsum(explained_ratio)
)
write.table(variance_out, "pca_variance.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE,
            quote=FALSE, na="NA")

summary_metric <- c(
  "analysis_method","matrix_orientation","raw_expression_sample_columns",
  "raw_expression_unique_sample_ids","metadata_rows","metadata_unique_projids",
  "repeated_primary_id_groups","excluded_unresolved_sample_columns",
  "fitted_resolved_samples","raw_gene_rows","retained_positive_variance_genes",
  "removed_zero_variance_genes","transform","pseudocount","centering","scaling",
  "requested_components","fitted_components","total_variance_denominator",
  "pc1_explained_variance_ratio","pc1_explained_variance_percent"
)
summary_value <- c(
  "classical PCA via R prcomp","samples as rows; genes as columns",
  as.character(length(sample_ids)),as.character(length(unique(sample_ids))),
  as.character(nrow(meta)),as.character(length(unique(meta_ids))),
  as.character(length(expr_dup_ids)),as.character(sum(!keep_sample)),
  as.character(nrow(X)),as.character(length(gene_ids)),as.character(ncol(X)),
  as.character(length(gene_ids)-ncol(X)),"log10(x + 1)",as.character(pseudocount),
  "feature-centered","unscaled",as.character(requested_components),
  as.character(requested_components),"sum of variances over all retained genes",
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_ratio[[1L]]),
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_percent[[1L]])
)
write.table(data.frame(metric=summary_metric,value=summary_value,
                       stringsAsFactors=FALSE), "pca_summary.tsv",
            sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, na="NA")

if (length(expr_dup_ids)>0L) {
  audit <- meta[meta$projid %in% expr_dup_ids, , drop=FALSE]
  audit$metadata_conflict_on_stable_field <- unname(metadata_conflict[as.character(audit$projid)])
  audit$identity_status <- "unresolved collision; excluded"
  audit$identity_reason <- "repeated primary projid without explicit secondary identity"
} else {
  audit <- data.frame(projid=character(0),
    metadata_conflict_on_stable_field=logical(0),
    identity_status=character(0), identity_reason=character(0))
}
write.table(audit, "identity_audit.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE,
            quote=FALSE, na="NA")
